title: What The Flamenco Guitar Knows — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish Italian philosophy language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The flamenco guitar does not ask permission to begin
It arrives like an argument and takes you from within
The rasgueado is a strum technique involving all five fingers
And watching it done properly is something that still lingers

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La guitarra flamenca sabe lo que el alma siente
[The flamenco guitar knows what the soul feels]
El duende aparece cuando la música es ardiente
[Duende appears when the music is burning]
Los dedos bailan sobre las cuerdas sin descanso
[Fingers dance over the strings without rest]
La guitarra flamenca es el espejo del avance
[The flamenco guitar is the mirror of progression]

[Chorus — English]
What does the flamenco guitar know that I don't know?
It knows the weight of Andalusia in every note below
What does the flamenco guitar know in the heat of night?
It knows that passion played correctly puts the audience in flight
That's my boy

[Bridge — Italian, with English translation]
La chitarra flamenca parla di passione vera
[The flamenco guitar speaks of true passion]
Ogni nota racconta una storia di primavera
[Every note tells a story of spring]
Il duende è quella magia che non si può spiegare
[Duende is that magic that cannot be explained]
La chitarra flamenca sa come far vibrare
[The flamenco guitar knows how to make things vibrate]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the flamenco guitar knows… Lo que sabe la guitarra flamenca… Quello che sa la chitarra flamenca
Duende is real — El duende es real — Il duende è reale
That's my boy
